title: Price Your Automation Projects for Real Business Value
summary: Build a practical pricing method that starts with the value your automation creates for a client, while protecting your own minimum sustainable rate.
directory_line: Learn to price by client value, with a sustainable floor and a clear proposal.
description: Visual preview only. This is an illustrative workshop, not a scheduled class.
audience: Freelancers, automation developers and consultants who want to quote projects confidently
leave_with: A calculator for your minimum sustainable project price.
A framework to estimate the client's value from time saved, errors reduced or faster collections.
Three defensible price options for a single automation proposal.
A one-page offer you can adapt for your next client.

run_of_show.title: Start with what the client needs
run_of_show.detail: Choose a narrowly defined business outcome

run_of_show.title: Live pricing clinic
run_of_show.detail: Review the offers and pressure-test assumptions

good_fit: You can build or maintain a workflow but want to be clearer about scoping and charging for it.
not_fit: You are looking for a guaranteed income formula or a certification issued for attending.
bring: a laptop, a calculator or spreadsheet and an example workflow to price.

faq.a: The pricing framework is accessible to beginners, but examples assume some familiarity with automation workflows.
No. Workshop attendance is practical training, not certification.
